title: Winds and the Witch of the Deep Cave | Read Along | Luna Story Time
description:
When the grownups of Castle Everstair mysteriously change, Winds and his friends venture beneath the bottom stair and meet a witch in a deep cave. Together they discover how ordinary rain can help restore what was lost.

Book Four of the Castle Everstair stories. Written with love by Luna and Sunny.

Listen and follow the highlighted words through this illustrated read-along, with a gentle original score.

Read the illustrated book: https://kolatts.github.io/luna-story-time/reader.html?book=winds-and-the-witch-of-the-deep-cave

Created with AI-assisted artwork, synthetic narration, and AI-generated music.
An Imagile family project.
